clues: This city lies in the center of New York state, far from the big sea port. It is the main town of its county and its whole zone.
This city gets more snow each year than any big metro zone in the land. One winter in the 1990s set its all time snow mark.
Set up for good in 1820, this city took its name from an old Greek city in Sicily. The two places shared the same kind of land.
Salty springs near this city made it a top salt maker for years. That salty past won it the proud tag of The Salt City.
A giant mall here ranks as the biggest in New York state. It stands as the tenth biggest mall in the whole land as well.
